history.p: "Viborg Domkirke" was written at the instigation of Adolph Nathan in Aalborg for De Jydske Sangforeningers Sangfest in 1874, which was attended by male choirs from all over the country. The old Viborg Cathedral had been demolished in 1863 and was reconstructed closely moddelled after the ancient Romanesque cathedral at Lund in southern Sweden. It was not inaugurated until 1876.
